capabilities: Restyle the reading page as grained paper with adjustable ink contrast and plain typography
Mark key sentences and focus on one sentence at a time while reading
Show related and similar notes as animated slips tied by threads under the note
Run a Pomodoro timer with soundscapes and a system-audio equalizer
Track reading habits with a quest log, streaks and a 365-day activity map
extras: Freemium: a paid Pro tier unlocked via crypto invoices or on-chain transactions; the free part works offline with no account. System-audio equalizer is Windows-only, the page stays light in dark theme, and the plugin is untested on macOS, Linux and mobile. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's reading view has no comfortable long-form reading layout and no built-in focus aids such as sentence highlighting, a focus timer or ambient sound.

requires.name: Pro tier (crypto payment via @CryptoBot invoice or USDT/BNB/Solana transaction)

summary: Reading and focus mode that restyles the note page as textured paper and adds a key-sentence marker, animated related-note threads, a Pomodoro timer and soundscapes.
